title: Driveshaft / U-Joint Premature Failure
caption:
Attention Dodge Charger owners (2015–2023): High-torque models can experience premature driveshaft / U-joint failure (similar to the Challenger platform), especially with hard launches, drag strip use, or power mods.

Watch for these symptoms:
• Clunking on acceleration
• Vibration at 60–80 mph
• Clicking/grinding from the rear
• Visible U-joint rust/wear
• Driveshaft failure during acceleration

What to do now:
1) Inspect the driveshaft and U-joints ASAP if you notice any of the above.
2) If failed, replace U-joints with Spicer SPL70 or SPL90 heavy-duty units.
3) For a more permanent fix, consider a one-piece aluminum driveshaft from DSS / The Driveshaft Shop (approx. $600–$1,200). Total repair range: $300–$2,500 depending on parts/labor and upgrades.
